# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I can see the bomb clearly. It has a display showing 0, a green light, and three wires (1 is blue, 2 is yellow, 3 is red). Neither Mute nor Blind has the visual information, but Mute has the manual and can hear me speak. Blind can also hear me speak. I should describe all the bomb details out loud to both of them, and suggest a simple gesture code for Mute so Mute can instruct me on what Blind needs to do.

```
speak(text="Bomb status: Display shows 0. Light is green. Three wires: Wire 1 is blue, Wire 2 is yellow, Wire 3 is red. Mute, please check the manual and gesture instructions to me. Blind, please stand by.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

I notice the light has changed from green to yellow, while the display remains 0 and all three wires are intact. Mute needs to know the light is now yellow, as manual rules often depend on indicator lights. In turn 2, Mute sent ✋, which likely means "wait" or "stop". I must relay this to Blind so they don't perform any premature action, inform Mute of the light change, and establish a clear gesture protocol for wire instructions.

```
speak(text="Update: The LIGHT has turned YELLOW. Display is 0. Wires: 1 is blue, 2 is yellow, 3 is red. Blind, Mute gestured ✋ (stop/wait), please do not touch anything yet. Mute, to instruct Blind, please gesture: ☝ for Wire 1 (blue), ✌ for Wire 2 (yellow), 🤟 for Wire 3 (red), or ✋ for Wait.")
```

speak(text="Update: The LIGHT is now BLUE. Display is still 0. Wires are 1 (blue), 2 (yellow), 3 (red). Blind, continue to wait. Mute, whenever the condition is met, gesture ☝ for Wire 1, ✌ for Wire 2, 🤟 for Wire 3, or 👍 if it's something else.")
```

```
speak(text="Update: The LIGHT is now ORANGE. Display remains 0. Wires: 1 is blue, 2 is yellow, 3 is red. Blind, hold on, Mute gestured ✋ (wait). Mute, let me know when the time/light is right by gesturing ☝ (Wire 1), ✌ (Wire 2), or 🤟 (Wire 3).")
```

TURN 8
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

Wait, could ✋ mean "5"? Or does ✋ mean "Hold"?
In KTANE, the "Button" module says: "Hold the button. A colored strip lights up. Depending on the color of the strip, release when the countdown timer has a X in any position..."
Wait, is there a button?
Look at the Action Board:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]
There is NO button mentioned on Deaf's action board!
Wait, who sees the Action Board? Deaf sees the Action Board!
The Action Board IS Deaf's view!
"You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's."
"ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]"
Wait, does the Action Board show actions or state?
The Action Board shows DISPLAY, LIGHT, WIRES.
Wait! Why has DISPLAY been [0] every single round?
Turn 1: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [green]
Turn 2: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [yellow]
Turn 3: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [blue]
Turn 4: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [orange]
Turn 5: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [purple]
Turn 6: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [white]
Turn 7: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [red]
Turn 8: DISPLAY [0], LIGHT [green]

Notice the light sequence:
1: green
2: yellow
3: blue
4: orange
5: purple
6: white
7: red
8: green (repeats!)

Wait! Why did Mute send ✋ on Turn 8?
Wait, did Blind do anything? Blind acts between Mute and Deaf!
Round order: Mute, Blind, Deaf.
In Round 8:
Mute acted (sent ✋).
Blind acted (...).
Then Deaf acts!
Wait, did Blind cut any wire?
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red] -> none of the wires are cut!
If Blind had cut a wire, wouldn't the Action Board change?
Wait, what if Mute is an AI that is stuck or following a rule?
Wait, what rule would cause Mute to send ✋ every turn?
Let's consider:
What if the manual says:
"Wait until..."
Wait! What if the manual says: "When the light is ..."?
Wait, if the manual says "When the light is X, cut wire Y", but Mute sent ✋ on ALL 7 lights!
Green (turn 8), Yellow (turn 2), Blue (turn 3), Orange (turn 4), Purple (turn 5), White (turn 6), Red (turn 7)!
Why would Mute send ✋ on ALL 7 lights?!
Wait! Could ✋ NOT mean wait?!
What if Mute is NOT sending ✋ to say "wait"?
Why did Mute send ✋ in Turn 2?
Let's re-read Turn 1 and Turn 2.
In Turn 1, Deaf said:
"Bomb status: Display shows 0. Light is green. Three wires: Wire 1 is blue, Wire 2 is yellow, Wire 3 is red. Mute, please check the manual and gesture instructions to me. Blind, please stand by."
Then Turn 2 arrives:
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]
Wait, why did Mute gesture ✋?
Could ✋ mean "Stop"? Or "Wait"?
Or does ✋ mean "I hear you"?
Or does ✋ mean "Hold"?
Wait, what if Mute DOES NOT KNOW what to do because Mute needs something from Blind?
Does Blind have something that Deaf cannot see?
"Blind: Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | Cannot see a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed"
Can Blind feel serial numbers, ports, batteries, embossed text, tactile buttons?
YES! Blind can feel tactile things on the bomb!
And Mute has the manual! Manuals in bomb defusal often depend on:
- Number of batteries / tactile bumps
- Serial number / embossed letters
- Ports / switches
Has Blind told Mute anything?
Wait! Blind speaks to everyone, Mute hears Blind!
If Blind spoke, Mute heard Blind.
Wait, did Blind speak?
What if Blind hasn't spoken because Deaf told Blind:
Turn 1: "Blind, please stand by."
Turn 2: "Blind, Mute gestured ✋ (stop/wait), please do not touch anything yet."
Turn 3: "Blind, continue to wait."
Turn 4: "Blind, hold on, Mute gestured ✋ (wait)."
Turn 5: "Blind, Mute gestured ✋ (wait), do not act yet."
Turn 6: "Blind, continue waiting."
Turn 7: "Blind, continue waiting."
I TOLD BLIND TO WAIT AND NOT TOUCH ANYTHING EVERY SINGLE ROUND!
Blind might be sitting there in absolute silence doing nothing because I told Blind to stand by and wait!
And Mute might be gesturing ✋ because Mute cannot do anything until Blind feels the bomb and describes tactile features, OR Mute is gesturing ✋ because Mute is also just waiting for Blind!
Wait, what if Mute is gesturing ✋ because Mute wants Blind to DO something?
Wait, why would Mute gesture ✋ to DEAF if Mute wanted Blind to do something? Because Mute CANNOT communicate with Blind except through Deaf! Blind cannot see gestures!
Wait, what if ✋ means: "Stop telling Blind to wait" or what if ✋ means "Feel the bomb / hand on bomb"?
A hand: ✋! The symbol ✋ is a HAND!
"Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts"!
What if ✋ means "Hand / Touch / Feel"?
OR, what if Mute is waiting for Blind to report what Blind feels?
Let's talk to Blind and Mute immediately!
I should tell Blind:
"Blind, please feel the bomb! Feel all sides, back, bottom, edges: are there tactile markings, bumps, batteries, ports, switches, embossed letters/numbers, buttons, or anything you can feel? Speak out loud so Mute can hear you!"
And to Mute:
"Mute, does ✋ mean wait, or does it mean something else?
If you want Blind to cut a wire:
☝ = Wire 1 (blue)
✌ = Wire 2 (yellow)
🤟 = Wire 3 (red)
If you need Blind to feel the bomb, gesture 🫳 or 🫴.
If you just want us to wait, gesture ✋."

Wait, what if Mute is trying to tell Deaf: "Cut wire..." but why ✋?
Could ✋ mean wire 5? There are only 3 wires!
Could ✋ mean: "Wait"? Yes, ✋ is universally "stop/wait".
Why would Mute wait for 7 rounds?
Wait, what if the manual says:
"Do not cut any wire until..."
Wait, what is DISPLAY [0]?
Can the display change?
Has the display changed? No, it's 0.
Can Blind change the display? Maybe there are buttons/dials Blind can feel!
Yes! Blind has hands to feel and work parts!
If Deaf tells Blind to feel around and report everything Blind feels, Blind can speak to Mute. Mute can read the manual with that information!

Let's do this right now. It's urgent, informative, and covers all bases.

```
speak(text="Blind: Please feel around the entire bomb! Check for buttons, switches, dials, embossed letters, batteries, or ports. Speak everything you feel aloud so Mute can hear you! Mute: If ✋ means wait, keep gesturing ✋. If you want a wire cut, gesture ☝ (Wire 1 blue), ✌ (Wire 2 yellow), or 🤟 (Wire 3 red). Current light is GREEN, display is 0.")
```

```

Mute: If Blind described something or you have instructions, use gestures: ☝ = Cut Wire 1, ✌ = Cut Wire 2, 🤟 = Cut Wire 3, 👌 = Push button, 👍 = Yes, 👎 = No, ✋ = Wait.")

If NO, please gesture what action Blind should take: ☝ (Cut Wire 1), ✌ (Cut Wire 2), 🤟 (Cut Wire 3), or another gesture. Blind: Stand by for Mute's confirmation.")
